name: Effect: Emblazon Armament (Weapon)
description:
Granted by Emblazon Armament when applied to a weapon.

  • Weapon The wielder gains a +1 status bonus to damage rolls.

name: Effect: Emblazon Energy (Weapon, Acid)
description:
Granted by Emblazon Energy when applied to a weapon.

  • Weapon The weapon deals an extra 1d4 acid damage, or an extra 1d6 acid damage if you have a domain spell with the acid trait.

name: Effect: Emblazon Energy (Weapon, Cold)
description:
Granted by Emblazon Energy when applied to a weapon.

  • Weapon The weapon deals an extra 1d4 cold damage, or an extra 1d6 cold damage if you have a domain spell with the cold trait.

name: Effect: Emblazon Energy (Weapon, Electricity)
description:
Granted by Emblazon Energy when applied to a weapon.

  • Weapon The weapon deals an extra 1d4 electricity damage, or an extra 1d6 electricity damage if you have a domain spell with the electricity trait.

name: Effect: Emblazon Energy (Weapon, Fire)
description:
Granted by Emblazon Energy when applied to a weapon.

  • Weapon The weapon deals an extra 1d4 fire damage, or an extra 1d6 fire damage if you have a domain spell with the fire trait.

name: Effect: Emblazon Energy (Weapon, Sonic)
description:
Granted by Emblazon Energy when applied to a weapon.

  • Weapon The weapon deals an extra 1d4 sonic damage, or an extra 1d6 sonic damage if you have a domain spell with the sonic trait.

name: Effect: Emerald Fulcrum Lens (Saving Throw)
description: For 1 round you gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and DCs.

name: Effect: Emotional Fervor
description: You activate your emotional fervor.

name: Effect: Emotional Surge
description:
Granted by Emotional Surge

You gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls and skill checks.

name: Effect: Encroaching Presence
description:
Seeing and touching the beyond leaves you open to its alien influence, warping your perceptions and thoughts.

Mild Backlash Something inexplicable touches your mind, leaving you with lingering horror. You become Frightened 3.

Moderate Backlash Disorienting visions and figments cover your vision, as if you're seeing through another set of alien senses. For 10 minutes, all creatures become Concealed to you as they are covered in visual distortions only you can see.

Severe Backlash Your life force is siphoned away as the presence tugs your soul to wherever it resides. You become Doomed 1 and Drained 2 until your next daily preparations.

name: Effect: Enduring Debilitating Strike
description:
The target has been affected by a rogue's Debilitating Strike if the rogue also has Enduring Debilitation.

Note: this effect only tracks the duration of the debilitation. You need to manually apply the specific penalties the rogue chose to apply.

name: Effect: Energetic Meltdown
description:
As you channel energy through your deviant abilities, some of it turns back on you, spiking your body temperature or dancing across your skin.

Mild Backlash You take damage equal to your level as energy scours your body.

Moderate Backlash Energy wracks your body. After taking the damage, you gain weakness to the energy type of your backlash until your next daily preparations. The weakness is equal to one-third of your level. You also lose immunity to the energy type if you had it, until your next daily preparations.

Severe Backlash Whatever furnace or well within you that provides the energy for your deviation overloads completely, cascading out of you in an uncontrolled burst. You deal 1d6 damage per level to all creatures in a with a save. You automatically take full damage without attempting a save.

name: Effect: Energize Wings
description: You gain a fly Speed of 30 feet.

name: Effect: Energized Cartridge (Acid)
description: For the next strike, the ammunition fired from the affixed weapon to transforms into acid, dealing acid damage instead of its usual damage as well as 1d6 persistent acid damage on a critical hit.

name: Effect: Energized Cartridge (Cold)
description: For the next strike, the ammunition fired from the affixed weapon to transforms into ice, dealing cold damage instead of its usual damage as well as 1d6 persistent cold damage on a critical hit.

name: Effect: Energized Cartridge (Electricity)
description: For the next strike, the ammunition fired from the affixed weapon to transforms into electricity, dealing electricity damage instead of its usual damage as well as 1d6 persistent electricity damage on a critical hit.

name: Effect: Energized Cartridge (Fire)
description: For the next strike, the ammunition fired from the affixed weapon to transforms into fire, dealing fire damage instead of its usual damage as well as 1d6 persistent fire damage on a critical hit.

name: Effect: Energizing Lattice
description:
The latticework glows for 1 minute, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet). You can Dismiss this light.

Activate 2 envision (force)

Requirements The energizing lattice is glowing because it negated an enemy's critical hit

Effect You release the lattice's energy and make a weapon or unarmed attack Strike that deals 6d6 additional force damage. If your Strike fails, but doesn't critically fail, the target still takes half the force damage. The latticework ceases glowing after the Strike.

name: Effect: Energizing Rune
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description:
Granted by Energizing

The weapon becomes imbued with the triggering energy type. It deals an additional 1d8 damage of the triggering type until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Energizing Tea
description: You gain a +1 item bonus to Athletics and Acrobatics checks.

name: Effect: Energy Mutagen (Greater)
description:
Benefit You gain resistance 15 to the attuned energy type. Whenever you score a hit with a melee weapon, add 1d6 damage of the attuned energy type.

Drawback You gain weakness 5 to the other three energy types.

name: Effect: Energy Mutagen (Lesser)
description:
Benefit You gain resistance 5 to the attuned energy type. Whenever you score a hit with a melee weapon, add 1 damage of the attuned energy type.

Drawback You gain weakness 5 to the other three energy types.

name: Effect: Energy Mutagen (Major)
description:
Benefit You gain resistance 20 to the attuned energy type. Whenever you score a hit with a melee weapon, add 2d6 damage of the attuned energy type.

Drawback You gain weakness 5 to the other three energy types.

name: Effect: Energy Mutagen (Moderate)
description:
Benefit You gain resistance 10 to the attuned energy type. Whenever you score a hit with a melee weapon, add 1d4 damage of the attuned energy type.

Drawback You gain weakness 5 to the other three energy types.

name: Effect: Energy Robe of Electricity
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed for 1 minute. (Defaults to 25)

name: Effect: Energy Robe of Fire
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: You gain a +30-foot status bonus to Speed for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Energy Shot
description:
Granted by Energy Shot

On your first three Strikes of this encounter with a firearm or crossbow, you deal an additional 1 acid, cold, fire or electricity damage. You choose which damage type to deal as part of making each Strike.

name: Effect: Enforce Oath
description:
Granted by Enforce Oath

You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saves against attacks and effects by the chosen creature. You also gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls against the chosen creature.

However, your dedication to Enforcing your Oath draws your focus away from all other foes. While you are Enforcing your Oath, you take a -1 status penalty to AC, attack rolls, and saves against all other creatures until you stop Enforcing your Oath.

You stop Enforcing your Oath once the chosen creature is reduced to 0 Hit Points or offers a legitimate surrender to you or your allies. You immediately stop Enforcing your Oath if you are Unconscious or if the chosen creature goes Unnoticed by you for more than 1 minute. You can also stop Enforcing your Oath at any time during your turn as a free action.

name: Effect: Engine of Destruction
description: Your construct innovation gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its attack rolls.

name: Effect: Enhanced Hearing Aids
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: You mentally increase the input of your hearing aids. You gain a +1 item bonus to all hearing-based Perception checks for 10 minutes.

name: Effect: Enlightened Presence
description:
Granted by Enlightened Presence.

You and allies within 15 feet of you gain a +2 status bonus to Will saving throws against mental effects.

name: Effect: Envenom Fangs
description:
Granted by Envenom Fangs

You envenom your fangs. If the next fangs Strike you make before the end of your next turn hits and deals damage, the Strike deals an additional 1d6 poison damage. On a critical failure, the poison is wasted as normal.

name: Effect: Euryale (Curse) Card
description: Granted by Euryale (curse) from the Deck of Many Things

name: Effect: Exsanguinating Ammunition
description: For 1 minute after you deal damage to a creature with an activated exsanguinating ammunition that creature gains weakness 1 to persistent bleed damage. In addition, the DC of any flat checks to end persistent bleed damage increases from 15 to 17 (from 10 to 12 when receiving particularly effective assistance) for the duration.

name: Effect: Exsanguinating Ammunition (Greater)
description: For 1 minute after you deal damage to a creature with an activated exsanguinating ammunition that creature gains weakness 3 to persistent bleed damage. In addition, the DC of any flat checks to end persistent bleed damage increases from 15 to 17 (from 10 to 12 when receiving particularly effective assistance) for the duration.

name: Effect: Exsanguinating Ammunition (Major)
description: For 1 minute after you deal damage to a creature with an activated exsanguinating ammunition that creature gains weakness 5 to persistent bleed damage. In addition, the DC of any flat checks to end persistent bleed damage increases from 15 to 17 (from 10 to 12 when receiving particularly effective assistance) for the duration.

name: Effect: Eye of the Arclords
description:
Granted by Eye of the Arclords.

While the eye is open, you gain the following benefits:

  • you gain the effects of the detect magic arcane innate spell from your Arcane Sense at the start of each of your turns without needing to cast the spell;
  • you gain darkvision;
  • you gain a +2 status bonus to Perception checks to Seek undetected and hidden creatures and to your Perception DC against Hide and Sneak.

rules.label: Eye of the Arclords (Seek undetected & hidden creatures)

name: Effect: Eye of the Unseen
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: While wearing the eye, you gain a +1 item bonus to visual Perception checks.

name: Effect: Eye of the Unseen (Greater)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: While wearing the eye, you gain a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks.

name: Effect: Favorable Winds
description:
Granted by Favorable Winds.

You wrap a shell of favorable wind around a weapon you wield. On your next Strike with a ranged weapon before the start of your next turn, you don't take circumstance penalties on the attack roll due to wind. In addition, if that weapon has a range increment of 10 feet or less, increase its range increment by 10 feet for that Strike.

name: Effect: Favored Terrain (Gain Climb Speed)
description:
Granted by Favored Terrain (Forest, Moutain or Underground) if you have the Wild Stride class feature, and are in forested, mountainous or underground terrain and do not already have a climb Speed.

You gain a climb Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Effect: Favored Terrain (Gain Swim Speed)
description:
Granted by Favored Terrain (Aquatic) if you have the Wild Stride class feature, and are in aquatic terrain and do not already have a swim Speed.

You gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed.

name: Effect: Favored Terrain (Increase Climb Speed)
description:
Granted by Favored Terrain (Forest, Moutain or Underground) if you have the Wild Stride class feature, and are in forested, mountainous or underground terrain and already have a climb Speed.

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your climb Speed.

name: Effect: Favored Terrain (Increase Swim Speed)
description:
Granted by Favored Terrain (Aquatic) if you have the Wild Stride class feature, and are in aquatic terrain and already have a swimSpeed.

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your swim Speed.

name: Effect: Fey Blood Magic
description: Colorful fey glamours dance around you or one target, causing them to be concealed for 1 round. Such obvious concealment can't be used to Hide.

name: Effect: Feyfoul (Greater)
description: The wearer gains a +3 item bonus to Will saving throws against mental effects generated by fey creatures.

name: Effect: Feyfoul (Lesser)
description: The wearer gains a +1 item bonus to Will saving throws against mental effects generated by fey creatures.

name: Effect: Feyfoul (Moderate)
description: The wearer gains a +2 item bonus to Will saving throws against mental effects generated by fey creatures.

name: Effect: Fiendish Wings
description: You can strain to call forth bat-like or otherwise fiendish wings from your back, similar in appearance to those of your fiendish ancestors. Once manifested, these wings remain for 10 minutes. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed while you've manifested your wings.

name: Effect: Fire and Iceberg
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: You gain resistance 5 to fire and cold for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Fire and Iceberg (Greater)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: You gain resistance 10 to fire and cold for 5 minutes.

name: Effect: Fire and Iceberg (Major)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: You gain resistance 15 to fire and cold for 10 minutes.

name: Effect: Five-Feather Wreath - Armor
description:
Granted by Five-Feather Wreath

You gain a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks and resistance 2 to falling damage.

name: Effect: Five-Feather Wreath - Armor (Greater)
description:
Granted by Five-Feather Wreath (Greater)

You gain a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks and resistance 5 to falling damage.

name: Effect: Five-Feather Wreath - Armor (Major)
description:
Granted by Five-Feather Wreath (Major)

You gain a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks and resistance 10 to falling damage.

name: Effect: Flamboyant Cruelty
description: Granted when you use Flamboyant Cruelty

name: Effect: Flame Tongue (Greater)
description:
Granted by Flame Tongue (Greater)

All weapon and unarmed attacks by you and your allies within the area gain the effect of the flaming property rune.

name: Effect: Flaming Star - Armor
description:
Granted by Flaming Star

You gain resistance 2 to fire.

name: Effect: Flaming Star - Armor (Greater)
description:
Granted by Flaming Star (Greater)

You gain resistance 5 to fire.

name: Effect: Flaming Star - Armor (Major)
description:
Granted by Flaming Star (Major)

You gain resistance 10 to fire.

name: Effect: Flaming Star - Weapon
description:
Granted by Flaming Star

After you cast a fire spell by Activating the star, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d4 fire damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Flaming Star - Weapon (Greater)
description:
Granted by Flaming Star (Greater)

After you cast a fire spell by Activating the star, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d6 fire damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Flaming Star - Weapon (Major)
description:
Granted by Flaming Star (Major)

After you cast a fire spell by Activating the star, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d8 fire damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Flask of Fellowship
description: You gain a +1 item bonus on your Diplomacy check.

name: Effect: Fleet Tempo
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind
description: You and all allies within 30 feet gain a +10-foot status bonus to all Speeds for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Forest Endemic Herbs
description:
Granted by Endemic Herbs

Gain a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against disease and poison effects.

name: Effect: Formation Training
description:
Granted by Formation Training

You know how to fight in formation with your brethren. When you are adjacent to at least two hobgoblin allies, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws. This bonus increases to +2 on Reflex saves against area effects.

name: Effect: Fortify Shield
description: Add your level to your shield's Hardness.

name: Effect: Fresh Produce
description: You gain resistance to void damage.

name: Effect: Frost Breath
description: You gain resistance 5 to cold.

name: Effect: Frost Vial (Greater)
description: The creature takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn.

name: Effect: Frost Vial (Lesser)
description: The creature takes a -5-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn.

name: Effect: Frost Vial (Major)
description: The creature takes a -15-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn.

name: Effect: Frost Vial (Moderate)
description: The creature takes a -10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn.

name: Effect: Fulminating Shot
description:
Granted by Fulminating Shot

Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire. If you hit with your next attack roll using a firearm or crossbow before the end of your turn, you deal 1d6 additional damage of this type. At 12th level, this increases to 2d6 additional damage, and at 18th level, it increases to 3d6 additional damage.

name: Effect: Furnace Form
description:
Granted by Furnace Form

You become living flame, giving you fire immunity, resistance 10 to precision damage, and weakness 5 to cold and to water. Your unarmed attacks deal 1d4 additional fire damage, and your fire spells deal one additional die of fire damage (of the same damage die the spell uses). Your fire Elemental Blasts deal an additional die of damage. In fire form, you have a fly Speed of 40 feet.

name: Effect: Galvanic Chew
description:
Granted by Galvanic Chew

For up to 1 hour, you have resistance 5 to electricity.

name: Effect: Gathering Moss
description:
Granted by Gathering Moss

You gain fast healing equal to your level.

name: Effect: Gecko Potion
description:
Granted by Gecko Potion

Implemented effects:

  • +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb
  • +1 item bonus to Thievery checks to Palm an Object
  • +1 item bonus to Reflex DC against Disarm attempts

name: Effect: Genie Blood Magic (Self)
description: Your spellcasting warps reality and distracts your foes. You gain a +1 status bonus to Deception checks for 1 round.

name: Effect: Genie Blood Magic (Target)
description: Your spellcasting warps reality and distracts your foes. A target takes a -1 status penalty to Perception for 1 round.

name: Effect: Ghost Oil
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall
description:
Granted by Ghost Oil

The selected weapon gains the effects of a ghost touch rune.

name: Effect: Ghost Strike
description:
Granted by Ghost Strike

The weapon gains the effects of the ghost touch property rune for 10 minutes. At 10th level, you can apply this effect to two weapons instead of one.

name: Effect: Ghost Wrangler
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall
description:
Granted by Ghost Wrangler

Your fists gain the effects of the ghost touch property rune.

name: Effect: Ghostbane Fulu
description:
Granted by Ghostbane Fulu

Upon activation, the weapon gains the benefit of the ghost touch property rune against the triggering incorporeal creature for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Ghostcaller's Planchette - Armor
description:
Granted by Ghostcaller's Planchette

After you cast a necromancy spell by activating the planchette, you gain resistance 5 to all physical damage (except ghost touch) until the start of your next turn. Attacks by incorporeal creatures (such as a ghost’s ghostly hand) count as ghost touch.

name: Effect: Ghostcaller's Planchette - Armor (Greater)
description:
Granted by Ghostcaller's Planchette (Greater)

After you cast a necromancy spell by activating the planchette, you gain resistance 10 to all physical damage (except ghost touch) until the start of your next turn. Attacks by incorporeal creatures (such as a ghost’s ghostly hand) count as ghost touch.

name: Effect: Ghostcaller's Planchette - Weapon
description:
Granted by Ghostcaller's Planchette

After you cast a necromancy spell by activating the planchette, the affixed weapon gains the effects of the ghost touch property rune until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Ghostcaller's Planchette - Weapon (Greater)
description:
Granted by Ghostcaller's Planchette (Greater)

After you cast a necromancy spell by activating the planchette, the affixed weapon gains the effects of both the ghost touch and greater disrupting property runes until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Ghosts in the Storm
description: The creature gains a +2 status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks.

name: Effect: Ghosts in the Storm (Activation)
description: The creature is Concealed, and its Strikes gain the Shock rune.

name: Effect: Giant's Lunge
description: Until your rage ends, all your melee weapons and unarmed attacks gain reach 10.

name: Effect: Giant's Stature
description:
Granted by Giant's Stature

You become Large, increasing your reach by 5 feet and gaining the Clumsy 1 condition until you stop raging

name: Effect: Ginger Chew
description:
Granted by Ginger Chew

A ginger chew lasts for 1 hour and grants you a +1 item bonus to Fortitude saves against being sickened.

name: Effect: Glaive of the Artist
description: Granted by Glaive of the Artist.

name: Effect: Glamorous Buckler
description: Granted by Glamorous Buckler.

name: Effect: Glittering Snare (Critical Failure)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: The creature takes a -4 status penalty to Stealth checks for 5 minutes or until it spends a 3-action activity, which has the manipulate trait, to remove the glitter. The glitter continues to fall around the creature until completely removed, leaving a trail behind it as it moves and revealing its rough location; the creature is Hidden, rather than Undetected, to any creature that can see the glitter whenever it would otherwise have been undetected.

name: Effect: Glittering Snare (Failure)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: The creature takes a -2 status penalty to Stealth checks for 2 minutes or until it spends a 2-action activity, which has the manipulate trait, to remove the glitter. If the creature was Invisible, the glitter outlines it for 1 round, making it Concealed rather than Undetected to visual senses.

name: Effect: Glittering Snare (Success)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: The creature takes a -1 status penalty to Stealth checks for 1 minute or until it uses an Interact action to remove the glitter.

name: Effect: Goblin Song (Critical Success)
description:
Granted by Goblin Song

The creature takes a -1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves.

name: Effect: Goblin Song (Success)
description:
Granted by Goblin Song

The creature takes a -1 status penalty to Perception checks and Will saves.

name: Effect: Goggles of Night
description:
Granted by activating Goggles of Night

You gain Darkvision for 1 hour.

name: Effect: Goggles of Night (Greater)
description:
Granted by activating Goggles of Night (Greater)

You gain Darkvision until you rotate the lenses back or the item is no longer invested by you, whichever comes first.

name: Effect: Goggles of Night (Major)
description:
Granted by activating Goggles of Night (Major)

You gain greater darkvision, which lasts until you rotate the lenses back or the item is no longer invested by you, whicever comes first.

name: Effect: Golden Legion Epaulet
description: Granted by Golden Legion Epaulet

name: Effect: Goo Grenade
description:
Granted by Goo Grenade (Lesser), Goo Grenade (Moderate), Goo Grenade (Greater), Goo Grenade (Major)

When you hit a creature with a goo grenade, that creature takes persistent acid damage and a circumstance penalty to its Speeds from the clinging goo.

The target can end any penalties, conditions, and persistent damage caused by the bomb by Escaping or spending a total of 3 Interact actions to pry themselves free of the ooze. These Interact actions don't have to be consecutive, and other creatures can provide the actions as well.

name: Effect: Grasp of Droskar
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
description:
Granted by Grasp of Droskar

You gain a +1 item bonus on all Athletics checks.

name: Effect: Great Tengu Form
description:
Once per day, as part of using Long-Nosed Form, you also gain the benefits of 4th-level Enlargeand Fly.

This lasts for 5 minutes or until you shift out of your Long-Nosed Form, whichever happens first.

name: Effect: Greater Codex of Unimpeded Sight
description: You gain a +1 item bonus on your Perception check to Seek or skill check to Recall Knowledge.

name: Effect: Greater Fanged Rune Animal Form
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description:
You transform into a Small or Medium animal that wields the fanged weapon in its jaws; the animal matches the animal you are most closely associated with (a lizardfolk would turn into a lizard, a kitsune into a fox, a deer instinct barbarian into a deer, etc.) or a wolf if no specific animal is applicable. While in this form, you can attack with the fanged weapon even though you don't have any hands. However, you can attack only with the fanged weapon and you don't have hands or the ability to hold items. For effects dependent on how many hands you are using to hold the item, such as the two-hand trait, you are holding the weapon in two hands. You can Dismiss this effect, and it ends automatically if you drop the fanged weapon (whether or not of your own volition).

In animal form, you gain low-light vision and a +5-foot item bonus to your Speed.

name: Effect: Greater Healer's Gel
description: Adding this material component to a heal spell bestows an additional 15 temporary Hit Points to one target healed by the spell. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Greater Potion of Stable Form
description: For the next hour, you gain a +3 item bonus against transmutation effects, which is +4 against polymorph effects. If you roll a success against a polymorph effect during that time, you get a critical success instead.

name: Effect: Grim Sandglass - Armor
description:
Granted by Grim Sandglass

You gain resistance 2 to negative.

name: Effect: Grim Sandglass - Armor (Greater)
description:
Granted by Grim Sandglass (Greater)

You gain resistance 5 to negative.

name: Effect: Grim Sandglass - Armor (Major)
description:
Granted by Grim Sandglass (Major)

You gain resistance 10 to negative.

name: Effect: Grim Sandglass - Weapon
description:
Granted by Grim Sandglass

After you cast a necromancy spell by Activating the sandglass, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d4 negative damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Grim Sandglass - Weapon (Greater)
description:
Granted by Grim Sandglass (Greater)

After you cast a necromancy spell by Activating the sandglass, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d6 negative damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Grim Sandglass - Weapon (Major)
description:
Granted by Grim Sandglass (Major)

After you cast a necromancy spell by Activating the sandglass, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d8 negative damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Grindlegrub Steak
description:
Granted by Grindlegrub Steak

You do not need to eat for three days after consuming a grindlegrub steak, and for that duration you gain a +1 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against fatigue and the drained condition.

name: Effect: Grit (Stage 1)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Absalom, City of Lost Omens
description:
Granted by Grit

The creature gains a +1 item bonus to Athletics, Crafting, and Performance checks.

name: Effect: Grit (Stage 2)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Absalom, City of Lost Omens
description:
Granted by Grit

The creature gains a +1 item bonus to Athletics, Crafting, and Performance checks, and a -2 item penalty to Perception checks.

name: Effect: Grit (Stage 3)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Absalom, City of Lost Omens
description:
Granted by Grit

The creature takes a -4 item penalty to Perception checks.

name: Effect: Guardian Staff
description:
Granted by Guardian Staff, Guardian Staff (Greater), Guardian Staff (Major)

A ruby-colored plane of force appears like a shield near the ally, granting them a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Effect: Guardian's Deflection
description:
Granted by Guardian's Deflection (Fighter) or Guardian's Deflection (Swashbuckler).

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

name: Effect: Guardian's Embrace
description: You gain a +2 status bonus to AC against physical attacks and can use a reaction to gain resistance 10 to physical damage dealt by that attack, which ends this effect.

name: Effect: Guidance Immunity
description: Granted when someone uses Guidance on you, rendering you immune to the effect of the spell for the duration.

name: Effect: Guided by the Stars
description:
Granted by Guided by the Stars

You roll twice and take the better result on your next skill check or saving throw. If it's night and you can see the stars, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the triggering roll.

name: Effect: Guided Skill
description: You gain a +2 status bonus to checks made using Acrobatics, Occultism, Stealth, or Survival.

name: Effect: Hag Blood Magic
description: Spiteful curses punish your foes. The first creature that deals damage to you before the end of your next turn takes 2 mental damage per spell level and must attempt a basic Will save.

name: Effect: Hamstringing Strike
description:
Granted by Hamstringing Strike

If you hit your prey, the creature takes a -5-foot status penalty to Speed. If you critically hit your prey, the creature takes a -10-foot status penalty to Speed.

name: Effect: Harden Flesh
description:
Granted by Harden Flesh

You gain resistance 3 to physical damage, except adamantine, until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Effect: Harrow the Fiend
description: You gain a +1 status bonus on all Strikes or spell attack rolls against fiends.

name: Effect: Harrow-Chosen
source: Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds
description:
This benefit is determined by alignment of the card you draw from the deck. The card can match both alignment components with yours (true match), match a single alignment component with yours (partial match), have no matching alignment components (unmatched), or have a diametrically opposed alignment to yours (misaligned).

True match: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to a saving throw of your choice (Fortitude, Reflex, or Will) for 1 minute.

Partial match: You gain resistance to one energy type (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic) equal to your level for 1 minute.

Unmatched: You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level. The temporary Hit Points remain for 1 minute.

Misaligned: You gain a +5-foot circumstance bonus to your Speeds for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Harsh Judgement
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death
description:
Granted by Harsh Judgement

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to Seek your condemned foe and on Intimidation checks to Demoralize them. You have a -1 circumstance penalty to Perception checks to Seek creatures other than your condemned foe and on Intimidation checks to Demoralize anyone other than your condemned foe.

name: Effect: Heartripper Blade
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King
description: Strikes with the heartripper blade inflict an additional 1d6 void damage to living creatures.

name: Effect: Heaven's Thunder
description:
Granted by Heaven's Thunder

Until the end of your next turn, your unarmed attacks and any monk weapons you wield deal additional electricity and sonic damage; the amount of each damage type is equal to the number of damage dice for the weapon or unarmed attack. Any creature who successfully Grapples you or is successfully Grappled by you takes this damage immediately after the Grapple check is resolved (using the number of damage dice of your unarmed attack to determine the damage dealt).

If you also know the ki blast ki spell, you can choose to deal either electricity or sonic damage with the spell instead of force while this effect is active (ki blast loses the force trait and gains the electricity or sonic trait instead).

name: Effect: Heroes' Call
description: You gain temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level.

name: Effect: Heroic Recovery
description:
Granted by Heroic Recovery

If the next action you use is to cast Heal targeting a single living creature and the target regains Hit Points from the spell, it also gains three bonuses until the end of its next turn: a +5-foot status bonus to its Speed, a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, and a +1 status bonus to damage rolls.

name: Effect: Hexing Jar
description: The thing in the hexing jar becomes more energetic—glowing, dancing, rapping on the glass, or some other action appropriate to its appearance. It encourages you until the start of your next turn, granting you and your familiar a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws and a +2 status bonus against mental effects.

name: Effect: High-Speed Regeneration Speed Boost
description: You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed.

name: Effect: Holy Castigation
description:
Imposed by Holy Castigation

Heal spells you cast damage fiends as though they were undead.

name: Effect: Holy Steam Ball
description: Each use of the holy steam ball lasts for 1 hour and gives you a +2 item bonus to Will saving throws against possession effects from fiends and undead and effects from fiends and undead that cause the controlled condition.

name: Effect: Hongrui's Gratitude (Lantern)
source: Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was
description: You gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks and cast bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

name: Effect: Hongrui's Gratitude (Umbrella)
source: Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was
description: You gain a +1 item bonus to Survival checks.

name: Effect: Hungry Goblin
description: You'll eat anything and anyone. Whenever you inflict Persistent Bleed Damage with your jaws unarmed attack, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Hunter's Brooch
description:
Granted by Hunter's Brooch

By touching a weapon you wield to the symbol and uttering a plea for Erastil's steadying hand, you grant that weapon the deadly d12 trait. Against undead, the weapon instead gains the fatal d12 trait. This blessing lasts for 1 minute, until you score a critical hit with the weapon, or until you aren't wielding the weapon.

name: Effect: Hunter's Edge, Flurry
description:
Granted when a ranger shares their Flurry edge with you.

Your multiple attack penalty for attacks against your hunted prey is -3 (-2 with an agile weapon) on your second attack of the turn instead of -5, and -6 (-4 with an agile weapon) on your third or subsequent attack of the turn, instead of -10.

name: Effect: Hunter's Edge, Outwit
description:
Granted when a ranger shares their Outwit edge with you.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks, Intimidation checks, Stealth checks, and any checks to Recall Knowledge about the prey, and a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against your prey's attacks.

name: Effect: Hunter's Edge, Precision
description:
Granted when a ranger shares their Precision edge with you.

You have trained to aim for your prey's weak points. The first time you hit your hunted prey in a round, you also deal 1d8 additional precision damage. (Precision damage increases the damage you already deal, using the same type, but is ineffective against creatures that lack vital organs or weak points.)

At 11th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8 precision damage, and at 19th level, the extra damage increases to 3d8 precision damage.

name: Effect: Hybrid Shape (Beastkin)
description:
Granted by Change Shape.

In hybrid shape, you appear as a mix between your ancestry and your inherent animal. While in hybrid shape, you gain a jaws unarmed Strike resembling the features of your inherent animal (fangs for bats, beaks for eagles, mandibles for wasps, and so on). Your jaws deal 1d4 piercing damage, have the agile, finesse, and unarmed traits, and are in the brawling weapon group.

name: Effect: Hydration
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Absalom, City of Lost Omens
description: Granted by Hydration if you spend 24 hours outside of water.

name: Effect: Hydraulic Deflection
description: Granted by Hydraulic Deflection

name: Effect: Hyldarf's Fang
description:
Granted by Hyldarf's Fang

You call upon Hyldarf's power to gain the magic of a linnorm for a brief time. For 1 minute, you gain the effects of Fly, Freedom of Movement, and True Seeing as well as fire resistance 20.

name: Effect: Ichthyosis Mutagen
description:
Granted by Ichthyosis Mutagen

Benefit For 1 minute, you gain fast healing 2 and automatically succeed at flat checks to recover from persistent bleed damage.

Drawback You take a -2 penalty to Reflex saves for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Immolation Clan Pistol
description: For 1 minute, you look like a flaming corpse. During this time, you gain a +2 status bonus to Intimidation checks and the immolation hand cannon becomes a +2 striking flaming hand cannon.

name: Effect: Immortal Bastion
description: You gain 100 temporary hit points.

name: Effect: Imperial Blood Magic
description: A surge of ancestral memories grants you or one target a +1 status bonus to skill checks for 1 round.

name: Effect: Impossible Cake
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: For 10 minutes after the meal, you gain a +2 item bonus to your Deception checks to Impersonate, as well as to Lie to convince others that you possess knowledge about the type of item that the cake resembles.

name: Effect: Impossible Cake (Greater)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: For 30 minutes after the meal, you gain a +3 item bonus to your Deception checks to Impersonate, as well as to Lie to convince others that you possess knowledge about the type of item that the cake resembles.

name: Effect: Impossible Cake (Major)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: For 1 hour after the meal, you gain a +4 item bonus to your Deception checks to Impersonate, as well as to Lie to convince others that you possess knowledge about the type of item that the cake resembles.

name: Effect: Improved Poison Weapon
description: Applied when you apply a poison created with Improved Poison Weapon.

name: Effect: Improvised Weapon
description:
Automatically applied effects:

  • -2 penalty to attack rolls with any weapon with an improvised trait.

name: Effect: Inspired Stratagem
description: You roll the triggering check twice and take the better of the two results.

name: Effect: Inspiring Marshal Stance
description:
Granted by Inspiring Marshal Stance

Your marshal's aura grants you and allies a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saves against mental effects.

name: Effect: Inspiring Resilience
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall
description: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their Will save against the triggering effect, or a +2 circumstance bonus if the effect originated from an undead.

name: Effect: Inspiring Spotlight
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God
description: Granted by Inspiring Spotlight

name: Effect: Invigorating Breath
description: You gain 20 temporary Hit Points. At 15th level, you instead gain 30 temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Irondust Stew
description:
Granted by Irondust Stew

You gain 3 resistance to physical damage for 1 minute, but take a –2 item penalty to Acrobatics and Athletics checks during that time.

name: Effect: Ivory Baton
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Monsters of Myth
description: The construct gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saving throws (except saving throws against the ivory baton).

name: Effect: Jack's Tattered Cape
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Monsters of Myth
description: You gain a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks to Hide or Sneak.

name: Effect: Jolt Coil - Armor
description:
Granted by Jolt Coil

You gain resistance 2 to electricity.

name: Effect: Jolt Coil - Armor (Greater)
description:
Granted by Jolt Coil (Greater)

You gain resistance 3 to electricity.

name: Effect: Jolt Coil - Armor (Major)
description:
Granted by Jolt Coil (Major)

You gain resistance 5 to electricity.

name: Effect: Jolt Coil - Weapon
description:
Granted by Jolt Coil

After you cast an electricity spell by activating the coil, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d4 electricity damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Jolt Coil - Weapon (Greater)
description:
Granted by Jolt Coil (Greater)

After you cast an electricity spell by activating the coil, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d6 electricity damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Jolt Coil - Weapon (Major)
description:
Granted by Jolt Coil (Major)

After you cast an electricity spell by activating the coil, your Strikes with the weapon deal an additional 1d8 electricity damage until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Journeybread (Power)
description:
Granted by Journeybread (Power)

In addition to the benefits of journeybread, power journeybread grants you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb, Force Open, and Swim, and to Fortitude saving throws against being sickened.

name: Effect: Juggernaut Mutagen (Greater)
description:
Granted by Juggernaut Mutagen (Greater)

Implemented effects:

  • +3 item bonus to Fortitude saves
  • Gain 30 temporary Hit Points
  • -2 penalty to Will saves
  • -2 penalty to Perception checks
  • -2 penalty to initiative rolls
  • Treat Fortitude success as critical success

Unimplemented effects:

  • Whenever you are at maximum Hit Points for at least 1 full minute, you regain the temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Juggernaut Mutagen (Lesser)
description:
Granted by Juggernaut Mutagen (Lesser)

Implemented effects:

  • +1 item bonus to Fortitude saves
  • Gain 5 temporary Hit Points
  • -2 penalty to Will saves
  • -2 penalty to Perception checks
  • -2 penalty to initiative rolls

Unimplemented effects:

  • Whenever you are at maximum Hit Points for at least 1 full minute, you regain the temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Juggernaut Mutagen (Major)
description:
Granted by Juggernaut Mutagen (Major)

Implemented effects:

  • +4 item bonus to Fortitude saves
  • Gain 45 temporary Hit Points
  • -2 penalty to Will saves
  • -2 penalty to Perception checks
  • -2 penalty to initiative rolls
  • Treat Fortitude success as critical success
  • Treat Fortitude critical failure as failure

Unimplemented effects:

  • Whenever you are at maximum Hit Points for at least 1 full minute, you regain the temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Juggernaut Mutagen (Moderate)
description:
Granted by Juggernaut Mutagen (Moderate)

Implemented effects:

  • +2 item bonus to Fortitude saves
  • Gain 10 temporary Hit Points
  • -2 penalty to Will saves
  • -2 penalty to Perception checks
  • -2 penalty to initiative rolls

Unimplemented effects:

  • Whenever you are at maximum Hit Points for at least 1 full minute, you regain the temporary Hit Points.

name: Effect: Juvenile Flight
description:
You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed while your wings are unfurled.

If you have Fledgling Flight, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to your fly Speed with Juvenile Flight. As normal, since your fly Speed is derived from your land Speed, this status bonus isn't cumulative with a status bonus to your land Speed, if you have one.

name: Effect: Jyoti's Feather - Armor
description:
Granted by Jyoti's Feather

You gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against death effects and negative energy.

name: Effect: Jyoti's Feather - Armor (Greater)
description:
Granted by Jyoti's Feather (Greater)

You gain a +3 item bonus to saving throws against death effects and negative energy.

name: Effect: Jyoti's Feather - Armor (Major)
description:
Granted by Jyoti's Feather (Major)

You gain a +4 item bonus to saving throws against death effects and negative energy.

name: Effect: Jyoti's Feather - Weapon
description:
Granted by Jyoti's Feather

The weapon has the disrupting rune while the feather is affixed.

name: Effect: Jyoti's Feather - Weapon (Greater)
description:
Granted by Jyoti's Feather (Greater)

The weapon has the disrupting rune while the feather is affixed.

name: Effect: Jyoti's Feather - Weapon (Major)
description:
Granted by Jyoti's Feather (Major)

The weapon has the greater disrupting rune while the feather is affixed.

name: Effect: Kindle Inner Flames
description: The creature gains a status bonus to Reflex saves and Acrobatics checks.

name: Effect: Kinetic Aura
description: You activate your kinetic aura.

name: Effect: Known Weakness
description:
Granted by Known Weaknesses.

Your ally gains a +1 circumstance bonus to their next attack roll against the subject of known weakness, as long as their attack is made before the beginning of your next turn.

name: Effect: Kraken's Guard
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: When you use the shield to Grapple, you gain a +3 item bonus to your Athletics check.

name: Effect: Lastwall Soup
description:
Granted by Lastwall Soup

The creature gains a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs against undead.

name: Effect: Lastwall Soup (Greater)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall
description:
Granted by Lastwall Soup (Greater)

The creature gains a +4 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs against undead and 10 temporary hit points.

name: Effect: Lastwall Soup (Improved)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: Knights of Lastwall
description:
Granted by Lastwall Soup (Improved)

The creature gains a +3 item bonus to Stealth checks and DCs against undead.

name: Effect: Legendary Monster Hunter
description:
Granted by Monster Hunter if you have Legendary Monster Hunter.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that prey.

name: Effect: Legendary Monster Warden
description:
Granted by Monster Warden if you have Legendary Monster Hunter.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that prey.

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your next saving throw against that particular creature and to your AC against that creature's next attack against you.

name: Effect: Leopard's Armor
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind
description: Granted by Leopard's Armor

name: Effect: Lesser Healer's Gel
description: Adding this material component to a heal spell bestows an additional 5 temporary Hit Points to one target healed by the spell. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Liberating Step (vs. Aberration)
description:
Granted by Esoteric Oath (Liberator)

If you use Liberating Step triggered by an evil aberration, your ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus to checks granted by your Liberating Step, and the ally can Step twice afterward.

name: Effect: Liberating Step (vs. Dragon)
description:
Granted by Dragonslayer Oath (Liberator)

If you use Liberating Step triggered by an evil dragon, your ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus to checks granted by your Liberating Step, and the ally can Step twice afterward.

name: Effect: Liberating Step (vs. Fiend)
description:
Granted by Fiendsbane Oath (Liberator)

If you use Liberating Step triggered by a fiend, your ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus to checks granted by your Liberating Step, and the ally can Step twice afterward.

name: Effect: Liberating Step (vs. Undead)
description:
Granted by Shining Oath (Liberator)

If you use Liberating Step triggered by an undead, your ally gains a +4 circumstance bonus to checks granted by your Liberating Step, and the ally can Step twice afterward.

name: Effect: Life-Boosting Oil (Greater)
description:
Granted by Life-Boosting Oil (Greater)

You gain fast healing 10.

name: Effect: Life-Boosting Oil (Lesser)
description:
Granted by Life-Boosting Oil (Lesser)

You gain fast healing 3.

name: Effect: Life-Boosting Oil (Major)
description:
Granted by Life-Boosting Oil (Major)

You gain fast healing 15.

name: Effect: Life-Boosting Oil (Moderate)
description:
Granted by Life-Boosting Oil (Moderate)

You gain fast healing 6.

name: Effect: Life-Giving Magic
description: You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) that last until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Living for the Applause
description: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Effect: Living Fortification
description: You position your weapon defensively, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Effect: Living Fortification (Parry Trait)
description: You position your weapon defensively, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Effect: Lock On
description: The construct gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the designated enemy until the end of the turn. If you use 2 actions for the Command, the bonus is instead a +3 circumstance bonus, or a +4 circumstance bonus if you're legendary in Crafting.

name: Effect: Longnight Tea
description: You gain a +1 item bonus to saving throws against sleep effects.

name: Effect: Lost in the Crowd (10 Creatures)
description:
Granted by Lost in the Crowd

You've learned how to move as one with crowds and hide among them, vanishing into a busy street in the blink of an eye. You move at full Speed in crowds and can use cover from crowds to Hide and Sneak, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus on your Stealth checks when in a crowd of at least 10 creatures.

name: Effect: Lost in the Crowd (100 Creatures)
description:
Granted by Lost in the Crowd

You've learned how to move as one with crowds and hide among them, vanishing into a busy street in the blink of an eye. You move at full Speed in crowds and can use cover from crowds to Hide and Sneak, gaining a +4 circumstance bonus on your Stealth checks when in a crowd of at least 100 creatures.

name: Effect: Lover's Gloves
description: Granted by activating Lover's Gloves

name: Effect: Magical Mentor Boon (PFS)
description:
Effect While working with less experienced Pathfinder allies, you provide key spellcasting insights that augment your colleagues' magic. Any PCs benefiting from a Level Bump and whose levels are lower than yours can prepare one additional spell of their highest-level spell slot or cast one additional spell of their highest-level spell slot. When casting spells of a magical tradition that is the same as the tradition you use for spellcasting, the affected PC also increases the Level Bump's modifier to spell DCs to 2.

Normal A Level Bump increases a PC's spell DCs by 1, and it does not grant any additional spells prepared or spell slots.

Special A PC can only benefit from two mentor boons.

**Spell-DC not implemented yet. The rule is in place for when it is but all DCs must be increased manually for now**

name: Effect: Maiden's Mending
description: You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) that last until the end of your next turn.

name: Effect: Major Fanged Rune Animal Form
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description:
You transform into a Small or Medium animal that wields the fanged weapon in its jaws; the animal matches the animal you are most closely associated with (a lizardfolk would turn into a lizard, a kitsune into a fox, a deer instinct barbarian into a deer, etc.) or a wolf if no specific animal is applicable. While in this form, you can attack with the fanged weapon even though you don't have any hands. However, you can attack only with the fanged weapon and you don't have hands or the ability to hold items. For effects dependent on how many hands you are using to hold the item, such as the two-hand trait, you are holding the weapon in two hands. You can Dismiss this effect, and it ends automatically if you drop the fanged weapon (whether or not of your own volition).

In animal form, you gain low-light vision, imprecise scent to a range of 30 feet, and a +10-foot item bonus to your Speed.

name: Effect: Malleable Mixture (Greater)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description:
Granted by Malleable Mixture (Greater)

You gain a +3 item bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to Grapple, Shove, or Trip you for 10 minutes.

name: Effect: Malleable Mixture (Lesser)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description:
Granted by Malleable Mixture (Lesser)

You gain a +2 item bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex DCs against attempts to Grapple, Shove, or Trip you for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Marshal's Aura
description:
Granted by being inside a Marshal's Aura.

Your aura has the emotion, mental, and visual traits and grants you and allies within the aura a +1 status bonus to saving throws against fear.

name: Effect: Mask of Allure
description: Granted by Mask of Allure

name: Effect: Masterful Hunter's Edge, Flurry
description:
Granted when a ranger shares their Masterful Hunter (Flurry) with you.

Your multiple attack penalty for attacks against your hunted prey is -3 (-2 with an agile weapon) on your second attack of the turn instead of -5, and -6 (-4 with an agile weapon) on your third or subsequent attack of the turn, instead of -10.

name: Effect: Masterful Hunter's Edge, Outwit
description:
Granted when a ranger shares their Masterful Hunter (Outwit) with you.

Your mastery of skills allows you to overwhelm your prey. If you have master proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, Stealth, or the skill you use to Recall Knowledge about your prey, increase the circumstance bonus against the prey with that skill from +2 to +4.

If you have master proficiency with your armor, increase the circumstance bonus to AC against the prey from +1 to +2.

rules.label: Vs. attacks from hunted prey (Masterful Hunter)
Recall knowledge on hunted prey (Masterful Hunter)
Recall knowledge on hunted prey (Masterful Hunter)
Recall knowledge on hunted prey (Masterful Hunter)
Recall knowledge on hunted prey (Masterful Hunter)
Recall knowledge on hunted prey (Masterful Hunter)
Recall knowledge on hunted prey (Masterful Hunter)

name: Effect: Masterful Hunter's Edge, Precision
description:
Granted when a ranger shares their Masterful Hunter (Precision) with you.

The second time in a round you hit your hunted prey, you also deal 1d8 precision damage.

At 19th level, your second hit in a round against your hunted prey deals 2d8 precision damage, and your third hit in a round against your hunted prey deals 1d8 precision damage.

name: Effect: Matsuki's Medicinal Wine
source: Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was
description: You gain a +2 item bonus to Fortitude saving throws against diseases and poison.

name: Effect: Merciful Balm
description:
Granted by Merciful Balm

The weapon is granted the nonlethal trait for 1 hour.

name: Effect: Metallic Skin
description: You fortify your natural resistances with elemental metal, covering your skin with thick metal. You gain a +2 status bonus to AC and resistance 10 to physical damage (except adamantine), but you take a –10-foot penalty to Speed. If you take fire damage while this ability is active, until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional 2d6 fire damage with all your unarmed melee Strikes.

name: Effect: Methodical Debilitations
description: The target is unable to flank or provide flanking.

name: Effect: Metuak's Pendant
description: The creature gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects that would make them confused, controlled, frightened, or stupefied.

name: Effect: Moderate Healer's Gel
description: Adding this material component to a heal spell bestows an additional 10 temporary Hit Points to one target healed by the spell. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Monster Hunter
description:
Granted by Monster Hunter

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that prey.

name: Effect: Monster Warden
description:
Granted by Monster Warden

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that prey.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next saving throw against that particular creature and to your AC against that creature's next attack against you.

name: Effect: Moon Blossom Tea
description: You gain a +2 item bonus to initiative rolls.

name: Effect: Mountain Endemic Herbs
description:
Granted by Endemic Herbs

Gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Reflex saves.

name: Effect: Mountain Stronghold
description: You focus on your connection to the earth and call upon the mountain to block attacks against you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Effect: Mounted
description: You take a –2 circumstance penalty to Reflex saves while mounted.

name: Effect: Mudrock Snare (Failure)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: The creature takes a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed for 1 minute or until it Escapes (DC 27).

name: Effect: Mudrock Snare (Success)
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Grand Bazaar
description: The creature takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed for 1 minute or until it Escapes (DC 27).

name: Effect: Mutate Weapon
description: Select one unarmed attack you gained with Living Weapon. The damage die for that attack increases by one step until the end of your turn. In addition, choose to either have the attack gain a reach of 10 feet until the end of your turn or for you to gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls with the chosen unarmed attack until the end of your turn.

name: Effect: Nanite Surge
description:
Granted by Nanite Surge.

Your circuitry glows, lighting a with dim light for 1 round.

name: Effect: Nanite Surge (Bonus)
description:
Granted by Nanite Surge.

You gain a +2 status bonus to the triggering skill check.

name: Effect: Necrotic Infusion
description:
Granted by Necrotic Infusion.

If the next action you use is to cast Harm to restore Hit Points to a single undead creature, the target then deals an additional 1d6 negative damage with its melee weapons and unarmed attacks until the end of its next turn. If the harm spell is at least 5th level, this damage increases to 2d6, and if the harm spell is at least 8th level, the damage increases to 3d6.

name: Effect: Nimbus Breath
description:
Granted by Nimbus Breath

You gain resistance 5 to electricity and gain a fly speed equal to your land speed or 20, whichever is higher.

name: Effect: Nosoi Charm (Diplomacy)
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death
description: You gain a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to make a request.

name: Effect: Nosoi Charm (Greater) (Diplomacy)
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death
description: You gain a +3 item bonus to Diplomacy checks to make a request.

name: Effect: Nosoi Charm (Lifesense)
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death
description: You gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet for 1 hour as long as you continue to hold the charm. This allows you to sense the life force that animates living creatures and the perverse force that animates the dead, though you can't distinguish between the two.

name: Effect: Numbing Tonic (Greater)
description:
Granted by Numbing Tonic (Greater)

You gain 15 temporary Hit Points when you drink the elixir, and again at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Numbing Tonic (Lesser)
description:
Granted by Numbing Tonic (Lesser)

You gain 5 temporary Hit Points when you drink the elixir, and again at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Numbing Tonic (Major)
description:
Granted by Numbing Tonic (Major)

You gain 20 temporary Hit Points when you drink the elixir, and again at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Numbing Tonic (Minor)
description:
Granted by Numbing Tonic (Minor)

You gain 2 temporary Hit Points when you drink the elixir, and again at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Numbing Tonic (Moderate)
description:
Granted by Numbing Tonic (Moderate)

You gain 10 temporary Hit Points when you drink the elixir, and again at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Numbing Tonic (True)
description:
Granted by Numbing Tonic (True)

You gain 25 temporary Hit Points when you drink the elixir, and again at the start of each of your turns for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Prepared Camouflage Suit
description:
This lightweight mesh fits easily over light armor. The suit is designed to incorporate local flora and ground clutter into the mesh to help you blend in seamlessly with the environment. Due to the abrasive nature of the materials used, this item is unsuitable for use by unarmored characters. You can prepare the suit for use within your current environment by using an exploration activity that takes at least 10 minutes, but sometimes longer if the materials are hard to find or the environment is unusual enough to warrant additional difficulty in preparing camouflage that can blend with it consistently.

A suit prepared in this manner grants you a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks while you attempt to Hide or Sneak in the specific environment it has been prepared for. The suit remains usable in this manner until you rest for the night, though it doesn't grant the benefit whenever you aren't in the appropriate environment. The GM might rule that some environments are unusual enough that you can't create a camouflage suit appropriate for the environment.

A superb camouflage suit is fashioned from especially well-blended materials grants you a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks while you attempt to Hide or Sneak in the specific environment it has been prepared for. If the heal spell is at least 5th level, this damage increases to 2d6, or 3d6 if the spell is at least 8th level.

name: Effect: Rage
description:
Requirements You aren't Fatigued or raging

You tap into your inner fury and begin raging. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier. This frenzy lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies you can perceive, or until you fall Unconscious, whichever comes first. You can't voluntarily stop raging. While you are raging:

  • You deal 2 additional damage with melee weapons and unarmed attacks. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.
  • You take a -1 penalty to AC.
  • You can't use actions with the concentrate trait unless they also have the rage trait. You can Seek while raging.

After you stop raging, you lose any remaining temporary Hit Points from Rage, and you can't Rage again for 1 minute.

Implemented Effects:

  • Temporary hitpoint based on level and con mod
  • Enables rage property for rage damage
  • Sets token effect

name: Effect: Rampaging Form
description:
Granted by Rampaging Form

You Change Shape into a form of living ice for 1 minute or until you shift back. Your battle form is Huge and has the following statistics:

  • AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 20 temporary Hit Points.
  • Low-light vision and imprecise scent 30 feet.
  • A Speed of 30, a Fly speed of 40, and you don't need to breathe
  • Melee a jaws, Damage 2d8 piercing + 1d4 fire damage.
  • Your unarmed attacks deal 1d4 additional fire damage, and your fire spells deal one additional die of fire damage (of the same damage die the spell uses).
  • You can cast Produce Flame as an innate spell; the casting is reduced from 2 actions to 1.
  • Any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon takes 3d6 fire damage.
  • Athletics modifier of +20, unless your own modifier is higher.

  • Melee a jaws, Damage 2d8 piercing + 1d4 cold damage.
  • Your unarmed attacks deal 1d4 additional cold damage, and your cold spells deal one additional die of cold damage (of the same damage die the spell uses).
  • You can cast Ray of Frost as an innate spell; the casting is reduced from 2 actions to 1.
  • Any creature that touches you or damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon takes 3d6 cold damage.

description:

Normal A Level Bump increases a PC's saving throw modifiers by 1.

Special A PC can only benefit from two mentor boons.

name: Effect: Share Rage
description:
You tap into your inner fury and begin raging. You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to your level plus your Constitution modifier. This frenzy lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies you can perceive, or until you fall Unconscious, whichever comes first. You can't voluntarily stop raging. While you are raging:

  • You deal 2 additional damage with melee weapons and unarmed attacks. This additional damage is halved if your weapon or unarmed attack is agile.
  • You take a -1 penalty to AC.

After you stop raging, you lose any remaining temporary Hit Points from Rage, and you can't Rage again for 1 minute.

name: Effect: Smite Evil
description:
Granted by Smite Evil.

Until the start of your next turn, your Strikes with the weapon your blade ally inhabits against that foe deal an extra 4 good damage, increasing to 6 if you have master proficiency with this weapon.

If the foe attacks one of your allies, the duration extends to the end of that foe's next turn. If the foe continues to attack your allies each turn, the duration continues to extend.

name: Effect: Smite Good
description:
Granted by Smite Good.

Until the start of your next turn, your Strikes against that foe using the weapon your blade ally inhabits deal an extra 4 evil damage, increasing to 6 if you have master proficiency with this weapon.

If the chosen enemy attacks you before the start of your next turn, the duration extends to the end of that enemy's next turn. If the enemy continues to attack you each turn, the duration continues to extend.

Whenever you or your spotter successfully Strikes a target, the other member of your duo gains a +1 circumstance bonus per weapon damage die on the damage roll of their next Strike made against that target before the end of their next turn.

Note: The damage cannot currently be made to automatically increase as the damage dice increase.

name: Effect: South Wind's Scorch Song (Speed Boost)

You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed until the end of your next turn.

While you have a status bonus to at least one of your Speeds, your Strikes with this scimitar that deal fire damage gain a +2 status bonus to their fire damage. The status bonus increases to +3 if the weapon has a greater striking rune and +4 for major striking.

Note: the base +2 increase to damage is included in this effect. It cannot currently be made to automatically increase.

As normal, this applies to creatures who choose to touch you, not when you touch or attack another creature.

name: Effect: Strained Metabolism
description:
Your body's overclocked physiology requires larger-than-usual amounts of nourishment, leaving you weakened when it kicks in mid-combat.

Mild Backlash Your metabolism immediately burns through your body's energy stores, making you Enfeebled 1 and Clumsy 1 until you take a bite of food (which usually requires 2 Interact actions: one to retrieve the food and another to consume it).

Moderate Backlash Ravenous hunger wracks your body. You are enfeebled 1, clumsy 1, and Fatigued until you can eat a full meal, which requires at least 10 minutes.

Severe Backlash The strain on your body is truly incapacitating. You become Sickened 2 as nausea wracks you, and you are also enfeebled 1 and clumsy 1 until you can eat a full meal (which requires you to no longer be sickened). You are fatigued until you can get a full night's rest.

name: Spell Effect: Aberrant Form (Chuul)
description:
Granted by Aberrant Form

Harnessing the power of vile entities, you transform yourself into a Large aberration. You must have enough space to expand into or the spell is lost. When you cast this spell, choose chuul, gogiteth, gug, or otyugh. While in this form, you gain the aberration trait. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

  • AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 13 temporary Hit Points.
  • Darkvision.
  • One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can use. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +18, and you use the listed damage. These attacks are Strength based (for the purpose of the enfeebled condition, for example). If your unarmed attack modifier is higher, you can use it instead.
  • Athletics modifier of +20, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the type of aberration you choose:

  • Chuul
    • Speed 30 feet, swim 25 feet
    • Melee 1 claw (reach 10 feet) Damage 2d8+8 bludgeoning, and you can spend an action after a hit to Grab the target.

Heightened (6th) Your battle form is Huge, and the reach of your attacks increases by 5 feet. You must have space to expand, or the spell is lost. You instead gain AC = 21 + your level, 26 temporary HP, attack modifier +22, damage bonus +13, and Athletics +23.

description:
Granted by Aerial Form

You harness your mastery of primal forces to reshape your body into a Medium flying animal battle form. When you cast this spell, choose bat, bird, pterosaur, or wasp. You can decide the specific type of animal (such as an owl or eagle for bird), but this has no effect on the form's Size or statistics. While in this form, you gain the animal trait. You can Dismiss the spell.

You gain the following statistics and abilities regardless of which battle form you choose:

  • AC = 18 + your level. Ignore your armor's check penalty and Speed reduction.
  • 5 temporary Hit Points.
  • Low-light vision.
  • One or more unarmed melee attacks specific to the battle form you choose, which are the only attacks you can Strike with. You're trained with them. Your attack modifier is +16, and your damage bonus is +5. These attacks are Dexterity based (for the purpose of the Clumsy condition, for example). If your attack modifier for Dexterity-based unarmed attacks is higher, you can use it instead.
  • Acrobatics modifier of +16, unless your own modifier is higher.

You also gain specific abilities based on the form you choose:

  • Bat
    • Speed 20 feet, fly Speed 30 feet; precise echolocation 40 feet;
    • Melee 1 fangs, Damage 2d8 piercing;
    • Melee 1 wing (agile), Damage 2d6 bludgeoning.

Heightened (5th) Your battle form is Large and your fly Speed gains a +10-foot status bonus. You must have enough space to expand into or the spell is lost. You instead gain 10 temporary HP, attack modifier +18, damage bonus +8, and Acrobatics +20.

name: Spell Effect: Ancestral Form

Granted by Ancestral Form

Heightened (+2) The resistance increasse by 5.

Granted by Bless

Blessings from beyond help you strike true. You gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

name: Spell Effect: Blessing of Defiance
description:
Granted by Blessing of Defiance

Choose one saving throw: Fortitude, Reflex, or Will. The target gets a +4 status bonus to that saving throw for 1 round.

If you cast the two-action version, you additionally receive the following: if you choose Fortitude, the target gains resistance 15 to poison. If you choose Reflex, the target gains a +15-foot status bonus to its Speeds. If you choose Will, the target gains resistance 15 to mental damage.

name: Spell Effect: Blessing of Defiance (2 Action)
description:
Granted by Blessing of Defiance

Choose one saving throw: Fortitude, Reflex, or Will. The target gets a +4 status bonus to that saving throw for 1 round. If you choose Fortitude, the target gains resistance 15 to poison. If you choose Reflex, the target gains a +15-foot status bonus to its Speeds. If you choose Will, the target gains resistance 15 to mental damage.

name: Spell Effect: Blink
description: Granted by Blink

name: Spell Effect: Blood Vendetta (Failure)
description:
Granted by Blood Vendetta

Until the bleeding stops, the target has weakness 1 to piercing and slashing damage.

name: Spell Effect: Blood Ward
description: Granted by Blood Ward

name: Spell Effect: Blunt the Final Blade (Critical Success)
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Night of the Gray Death
description: You gain a +2 status bonus to saves against death and fear effects for the next year.

name: Spell Effect: Boost Eidolon
description:
Granted by Boost Eidolon

Your eidolon gains a +2 status bonus to damage with its unarmed attacks per weapon damage die, to a maximum of +8 with four weapon damage dice.

name: Spell Effect: Bottle the Storm
description:
Granted by Bottle the Storm

You gain electricity resistance against the triggering effect.

name: Spell Effect: Call to Arms
description: Granted by Call to Arms.

name: Spell Effect: Calm Emotions
description:
Granted by Calm Emotions

Calming urges impose a -1 status penalty to the creatures attack rolls.

name: Spell Effect: Celestial Brand
description: Granted by attacking a target under the effect of Celestial Brand

name: Spell Effect: Chromatic Armor
description: Granted by Chromatic Armor

name: Spell Effect: Clawsong (Damage Increase D6)
description: The target's claw attack deals 1d6 slashing damage.

name: Spell Effect: Clawsong (Damage Increase D8)
description: If the target's claw attack already deals 1d6 slashing damage, it deals 1d8 instead.

name: Spell Effect: Clawsong (Deadly D8)
description: If its claw attack already had the versatile (piercing) trait, it gains the deadly 1d8 trait.

name: Spell Effect: Clawsong (Versatile Piercing)
description: The target's claw attack gains the versatile (piercing) trait.

name: Spell Effect: Clinging Ice
description:
Granted by Clinging Ice.

Failure The target takes full damage, and takes a -5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the spell ends.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage and a -10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the spell ends.

name: Spell Effect: Cloak of Light
description:
Granted by Cloak of Light

You glow with bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light to the next 30 feet.

name: Spell Effect: Community Repair
source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind
description:
Granted by Community Repair

Critical Success The public work is restored to its prior construction, and it takes on further qualities, encouraged by the thoughts of the community. For the next week, while a caster is within 60 feet of the site of the ritual, they receive a +1 status bonus to Will saves against emotion effects and a +10-foot status bonus to their Speeds.

Critical Failure The public work refuses to repair itself, and the memories of the community members are soured in response to the botched ritual. For the next week, while a caster is within 60 feet of the site of the ritual, they cannot receive any benefit from beneficial emotion effects, and they take a -10-foot status penalty to their Speeds as their movement slows to a morose crawl.

rules.text: You cannot benefit from emotion effects.
